Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Kingdom of Rock" was released earlier than "Was I the Wave?" despite the WebSurfer providing the correct release dates for both albums. The Planner misinterpreted the chronological order of the dates, as April 26, 2011 (Was I the Wave?) is earlier than November 6, 2015 (Kingdom of Rock). This error directly led to the wrong solution for the problem.
